name: @deepsea/variant-identity
description: DeepSea plugin: tells variants apart in any browser. The sidebar wordmark and the window title read the variant's display name, the whale (sidebar and favicon) takes its colour and the build-version chip is quietened, all from $DSH_HOME/variant.yml unless configured. Host-only.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check identity.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
